name: Bounty Hunter's Gambit
author: FRO_PWR
summary: Capturing a randomly chosen piece type earns $5; the target changes after every trigger.
description: Picks a random piece type as its bounty target. Capture that type and you earn $5 plus a money-spawn effect, then a new random target is chosen. The card's own description updates live to show the current target.
